description: Represents the visual style of a spreadsheet cell.

members.name: Clone
members.description: Creates a deep copy of this style.

members.name: BackgroundColor
members.description: The background fill color in hex format. Defaults to transparent.

members.name: Bold
members.description: Whether the text is bold.

members.name: BorderBottom
members.description: The border at the bottom edge of the cell.

members.name: BorderLeft
members.description: The border at the left edge of the cell.

members.name: BorderRight
members.description: The border at the right edge of the cell.

members.name: BorderTop
members.description: The border at the top edge of the cell.

members.name: DoubleUnderline
members.description: Whether the text has double underline.

members.name: FontFamily
members.description: The font family name (e.g. Arial, Calibri).

members.name: FontSize
members.description: The font size in points.

members.name: ForeColor
members.description: The foreground (text) color in hex format. Defaults to black.

members.name: HorizontalAlign
members.description: The horizontal alignment of cell content.

members.name: Indent
members.description: Indent level (0–15). Each level adds 12px left padding.

members.name: Italic
members.description: Whether the text is italic.

members.name: NumberFormat
members.description: The number format string (e.g. #,##0.00, yyyy-mm-dd).

members.name: ShrinkToFit
members.description: Whether to shrink text to fit the cell width.

members.name: StrikeThrough
members.description: Whether the text is struck through.

members.name: TextRotation
members.description: Text rotation in degrees (-90 to 90). 0 = normal horizontal.

members.name: TextWrap
members.description: Whether text wraps inside the cell.

members.name: Underline
members.description: Whether the text is underlined.

members.name: VerticalAlign
members.description: The vertical alignment of cell content.
